topic: Dreading a hard session: the workout we fear all day is heavier in our head than under the bar; we stop rehearsing the dread and just start the first set
figure: Seneca (Moral Letters 13.4: there are more things likely to frighten us than to crush us; we suffer more often in imagination than in reality). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: เซสชันที่เรากลัวมาทั้งวัน
